cases.question: What are the core components of RAG Proving Ground?
cases.ground_truth: The core components of RAG Proving Ground are documentation parsing, chunking, embedding/indexing, retrieval, generation (routing/citation), and evaluation. It is structured as a monorepo containing apps/backend, apps/web, packages/rag-core, packages/graphs, and experiments.

cases.question: RAG Proving Ground 프로젝트의 핵심 설계 원칙은 무엇인가요?
cases.ground_truth: 핵심 설계 원칙은 비동기식 파이프라인(Asynchronous Ingestion), 모듈화 및 확장성(Modularity & Extensibility), 점진적 고도화(Incremental Complexity) 입니다.
